Today’s failing approach: early career hiring on resumes and generic online tests
description
Challenge 1: Resume screening
Most early career applicants have limited formal work experience. A resume gives your recruiters little evidence to compare. Your team can then miss candidates who would perform well in the role. A resume screen can also favor candidates with the most traditional backgrounds.
function
Challenge 2: Academic coding problems
A test built on theoretical algorithms can miss the skills a new engineer uses in the first 90 days. Those skills can include debugging existing code. When your team recruits from bootcamps and self-taught communities, overly academic problems can disadvantage those candidates.
help
Challenge 3: Unfamiliar test formats
Many early career candidates are unfamiliar with online coding assessments. Anxiety about the format can lower performance or lead candidates to drop out. Early career candidates may also be less likely than experienced engineers to ask about an unclear instruction.
smart_toy
Challenge 4: Unclear AI rules
Early career developers widely use AI coding tools, including ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot. Without a clear policy in the assessment, candidates may use those tools by default. Your reviewers then have no rule to judge a result against.
Together, these gaps can keep skilled candidates from nontraditional backgrounds out of early career hiring.
An early careers assessment platform for entry-level engineering roles
Codility Screen is an early careers assessment platform for software engineering roles, including new grad and internship hiring. Candidates complete work simulations in a realistic coding environment. Your reviewers see each candidate’s score beside the code that candidate submitted.
Assess every entry-level applicant at the same junior level
Codility Screen sends applicants for the role an assessment with the same time limit and task criteria. Your team can choose tasks from the Codility library by difficulty level to fit a junior role. Your team can also randomize tasks to limit answer sharing. Candidates may then receive different tasks from the selected pool.
For an early career assessment, Codility recommends one or two tasks and 30 to 45 minutes. Codility automatically scores submissions for selected tasks against the task’s test cases.

Set the AI rules for each assessment and review the evidence
Codility lets your team enable or disable the AI Assistant for each assessment. When the AI Assistant is on, Codility captures every candidate interaction as reviewable AI activity. The assessment invitation can list the permitted AI tools.
Codility Screen can also collect integrity signals. Integrity signals show your reviewers which parts of a session they may want to examine. Signals include paste events, tab switches and matches with other submissions. The Code Evolution Chart places paste events and tab switches on a timeline of how the candidate’s code changed.
Your reviewers can examine the evidence behind each integrity signal before you decide who advances.

Questions about early career talent assessment
Codility Screen supports early talent recruitment for software engineering roles, including new grad hiring and internship programs. Candidates complete work simulations sized for a junior role in a realistic coding environment. Your reviewers see each score beside the submitted code.
Two things make a technical screening tool work for entry-level roles: tasks scoped to junior skill and a short assessment. Codility recommends one or two tasks and 30 to 45 minutes for early career candidates. Codility shows the time each candidate used on each task. Your team can use that data to check whether the assessment length suits your candidates.
Your team applies the same job-related assessment plan and conditions to every candidate, then checks the results by group.
Test the work of the role.
Your team chooses work simulations that reflect entry-level engineering work and avoids overly academic problems. Your engineers can also build a custom Codility task from a job description with Build with MCP. Build with MCP runs inside your engineers’ own AI coding assistant.
Hold the conditions equal.
In practice, every candidate receives the same instructions, time limit and AI Assistant setting.
Offer practice to everyone.
A demo test lets every candidate get familiar with the Codility platform before the scored assessment.
Score the output the same way.
Codility gives the same submission the same score every time, whatever the candidate’s background.
Check results by group.
As part of its professional services, Codility conducts adverse impact analyses aligned with EEOC guidance. An adverse impact analysis checks whether any demographic group passes at a disproportionately lower rate. Demographic groups include sex and ethnic groups. The methods include the four-fifths rule and statistical testing.
